name: cache-keepalive
description: Keep the session's prompt cache warm while you are away: /keepalive N forks a tiny request every ~50 min, at most N times per idle stretch

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the mod's messages. auto follows LC_ALL / LC_MESSAGES / LANG and falls back to English (the usual result on Windows)

intervalMinutes.title: Ping interval (minutes)
intervalMinutes.description: Minutes after the last request before each keep-alive ping; keep it under the cache TTL

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Cache TTL (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: The prompt cache TTL; once the last request is older than this, pinging is pointless and the mod stops

defaultMax.title: Default max pings
defaultMax.description: Max pings per idle stretch when /keepalive is run as `on`

retryMinutes.title: Retry wait (minutes)
retryMinutes.description: Minutes to wait before retrying a ping that failed with an API error; each retry counts as an attempt
